title: Magna Raedarum: Marburgum II — Foundational Game Ontology
description: Engine-neutral descriptive vocabulary; not yet a runtime schema or validator.

conventions.ids: Stable, namespaced; never use display names as keys.
conventions.relation_cardinality: The number of targets per source entity; 0..*, 0..1, 1, 1..*.
conventions.source_facts: A source record, historical assertion, fictional identity and engine projection are distinct.
conventions.authority: Consequential mutation requires authoritative processing and idempotent receipts.
conventions.progression: Skills without talents; 0–1990 legacy cap under review in MarburgumII.

types.description: The authoritative semantic city/world context.
A geographically or semantically identifiable location; may overlap other places.
A named district, quarter, local community or gameplay region.
A structure with location, function and optional accessible interiors.
A traversable road-network element used by mobility and access.
A river, lake or other hydrological place.
Source evidence with date, license, spatial reference and traceability.
A sourced, time-scoped claim about a real historical condition.
Approved in-game identity, function or name for a referenced place.
An individual in-world person with identity and state.
The in-world character controlled by a player.
A non-player character with authored or simulated behaviour.
An institution, shop, employer, association or other social entity.
An aggregated category of virtual inhabitants used by simulation.
A contextual tie between a character and a person or organization.
An authored area of learned activity and progression rules.
One character's XP and proficiency for a registered skill.
A character's reversible public standing and remembered history.
An authored item kind and its constraints.
An individually identified held or world item; stacks may represent fungible goods.
An authoritative container or custody record for items.
A balance in an explicit currency with integer minor units.
A time- and place-scoped proposed economic exchange.
An idempotent, committed economic transfer with an auditable receipt.
An authored story, job, favor, side or investigation contract.
Per-character or future per-party execution/progress of a mission.
A checkable authored mission condition or step.
A discoverable record, testimony, photograph, item or observation.
A durable player decision affecting one or more domains.
An available action verb and eligibility/effect rules.
A recorded outcome of an accepted interaction.
A data-driven vehicle archetype and its characteristics.
A specific vehicle with state, position and occupants.
A trip with origin, destination, progress and possible cost/vehicle.
Shared in-world date, time and temporal scheduling context.
The time-varying weather and environmental conditions.
An occurrence capable of changing shared world state.
Durable, versioned authoritative state or event projection.

relations.description: World membership; overlapping semantic place bounds are allowed.
A location can intersect multiple administrative/gameplay districts.
Source evidence is not automatically historical truth.
A historical claim must point to provenance.
A location may have multiple authored time-scoped identities.
Claims include period and confidence.
A character's semantic position, separately from Unreal render state.
Employment, social ties or institutional membership.
Virtual population classification if used.
A contextual relationship to a target person or institution.
Optional personal target of the relationship.
Optional organizational target of the relationship.
At most one current state per character and registered skill definition.
Progress references its immutable skill definition.
Reversible broad reputation separate from contextual ties.
Character custody of inventory containers.
Each persistent item has at most one current authoritative custodian.
Physical instance or stack references its item definition.
Account includes currency and integer minor-unit balance.
Business or institution can offer goods/services.
An offer refers to item definitions and validated quantities.
Committed transfer must reconcile inventory and money.
Progress is currently per-character unless party semantics are defined.
A run references an authored mission definition.
Authored mission completion criteria.
Discovered knowledge need not equal the underlying truth.
Durable choice with authoritative consequences.
Accepted interactions produce at most one committed outcome per operation identity.
Every player/NPC action has an initiating actor.
Separate an archetype from a concrete vehicle.
A trip may take place on foot or in transport.
Journey origin.
Journey destination.
One canonical world timeline per shared world context.
Time/region-scoped environmental conditions.
Committed simulation events.
Durable consequences require authority and replay safety.
